description: Company-scoped retrieval golden set for the 10-company corpus (latest 10-K each). Two queries per filer. A chunk is relevant iff it contains the query's 'evidence' phrase matched on WORD BOUNDARIES (naive substring matching is unsafe: 'AWS' matches inside 'laws'). Every evidence phrase was verified to occur in exactly one company's filing, so cross-filer distractors are true negatives — which is what makes metadata pre-filtering measurable. Queries are phrased as analyst questions rather than copies of the evidence.

queries.query: Why is adding or changing suppliers costly and slow for Apple?
What regulatory pressure does Apple face over its App Store?
Who competes with Microsoft's Azure cloud platform?
How is Microsoft adding generative AI capabilities across its products?
What are Alphabet's Other Bets and how do they perform financially?
How does Alphabet describe its cloud computing business and its growth?
What is Meta's virtual and augmented reality segment and what does it cost?
Which apps make up Meta's main consumer products segment?
How does Amazon describe its cloud computing segment?
What risks does Amazon face in its logistics and fulfillment operations?
What is NVIDIA's parallel computing software platform and why does it matter?
What does NVIDIA say about its Hopper GPU architecture?
